# r4e_rank output (generated by r4e_rank.py)

Factor definitions: F=log10(1+entries per covered day), S=ln(effective sources=1/HHI over node/source), P=active days/covered days (BGL) or active hours/covered hours (OpenStack), T=clip(log2 trend_ratio,±3), R=1-recency/span, Tm=placeholder Team count (constant 1 -> 0). Trend set neutral when n_recent+n_base < 30 (evidence floor). Default composite weights: {'F': 0.25, 'S': 0.25, 'P': 0.15, 'T': 0.15, 'R': 0.1, 'Tm': 0.1}
